claim: At its meeting on Thursday 26 November 2026 the Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Board raises the base rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, with at least one member dissenting in favour of keeping it at 3.00%.

runs.yes_requires: On 26 November 2026, within the stated Asia/Seoul event window, the Bank of Korea must announce that the Monetary Policy Board raised the Base Rate by 25 basis points from 3.00% to 3.25%. At least one member must have dissented in favor of keeping it at 3.00%; a dissent in favor of a larger hike does not count.
runs.decided_by: The Bank of Korea's announcement establishes the rate decision. The dissent can be established by the Bank of Korea's decision statement, the governor's post-meeting press conference, or same-day repo
